name: Enshrouded (mbround18)
author: pmurch@noway.com
description: Enshrouded dedicated server powered by the mbround18/enshrouded-docker image. Install, config generation, Proton launch, and graceful shutdown are all handled inside the image; the egg only wires it to Pelican. Game files install into the server root on first boot.
startup: echo '[egg] phase 1/4: runtime setup' && enshrouded setup && echo '[egg] phase 2/4: install (downloads game on first boot — SteamCMD progress uses carriage returns, so long quiet stretches are normal)' && { ([ -f enshrouded_server.exe ] && [ "${UPDATE_ON_START}" != "1" ]) || enshrouded install; } && { enshrouded monitor >/dev/null 2>&1 & } && echo '[egg] phase 3/4: starting server' && enshrouded start && echo '[egg] phase 4/4: following session log' && tail -c0 -F ./logs/enshrouded_server.log

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Enshrouded (mbround18) install/reinstall hook
#
# The game itself is downloaded by the mbround18 image when the server first
# starts, so there is nothing to install here. This script gives the panel's
# Reinstall button real meaning: it wipes runtime state accumulated on the
# server volume (SteamCMD bootstrap cache and the Wine/Proton prefix), which
# is the only state that can ever end up half-built. Saved games (savegame/),
# server config (enshrouded_server.json), and the game files themselves are
# left untouched; the next boot rebuilds the wiped state.

cd /mnt/server || exit 1

echo "Reinstall: wiping runtime state (SteamCMD cache, Wine/Proton prefix)..."
rm -rf .proton .local .steam Steam
echo "Done. Next start re-bootstraps SteamCMD and rebuilds the Proton prefix."
echo "Tip: to also force a fresh game download, delete enshrouded_server.exe in the file manager."

variables.name: [GAME] Server Name
variables.description: The name of the server shown in the server browser.

variables.name: [GAME] Game Port
variables.description: The game connection port. Set to the server's primary allocation port.

variables.name: [GAME] Query Port
variables.description: The server query port. Add a second allocation matching this port (UDP and TCP).

variables.name: [GAME] IP
variables.description: IP the server binds to. Leave as 0.0.0.0 unless you know you need something else.

variables.name: [GAME] Admin Password
variables.description: Password for the Admin user group.

variables.name: [GAME] Guest Password
variables.description: Password for the Guest user group.

variables.name: [SERVER] Update On Start
variables.description: Check for a server update via SteamCMD on every boot. The game is always installed automatically on first boot.

variables.name: [SERVER] Webhook URL
variables.description: Optional webhook (e.g. Discord) notified on server start/stop and player join/leave. Leave empty to disable notifications.

variables.name: [SYSTEM] Health Port
variables.description: Port serving the image health endpoints (/live, /ready, /health) for external monitoring. Set 0 to disable.
